farm_code_id.description: WASM code id of the `choice-farm` contract that this factory should spawn on `CreateFarm`.

farm_owner.description: Address installed as the `Config.owner` AND wasm admin of every farm spawned by this factory. Should be the Choice governance multisig so users can trust that no individual launch operator can change a farm's schedule or drain undistributed rewards. Captured per-farm at create time; updating this only affects future farms.

fee_collector.description: Address that receives every `CreateFarm` INJ fee.

instantiate_fee_inj.description: Anti-spam launch fee, denominated in `inj` base units (1 INJ = 1e18).

owner.description: Owner of the factory. Receives admin powers (UpdateConfig, owner rotation). Should be a timelocked multisig in production.
